function.name: lookup_fact
function.description: Look up one SEC EDGAR XBRL fact for a ticker, metric, and quarter or fiscal year. Successful results include period (the normalized requested label, or the resolved label for latest), duration_days, and period_type (quarter, ytd, annual, or instant). Additive flows may return derived=true with derivation and components; never treat a ytd result as a quarter or recompute a derived result.

function.name: list_periods
function.description: List the recent directly available SEC EDGAR quarter and fiscal-year periods for a ticker and metric.

function.name: compute_change
function.description: Compute the absolute and year-over-year change for one SEC EDGAR XBRL metric. The period and base_period must be the same kind of period; when base_period is omitted, null, empty, "null", or "none", use the same quarter or fiscal year one year earlier. The result includes both cited lookup facts and a percentage change in percent points.

function.name: history_rank
function.description: Compare one quarter or fiscal-year fact with every available comparable period of the same period_type. Quarters include derived Q4 values when available; annual periods are compared only with annual periods. Return the rank, record flags through the requested period, prior high/low, and the comparison window with period end dates.
